fusions.name: Sidestep Shove
fusions.desc: Feints one way and barges the other, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 2.5 tiles back. Each has a 40% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Played False
fusions.desc: Butts a target at or below 30% health for 16 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and 50% more damage for each one consumed. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

fusions.name: Decoy Charge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A decoy fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Baited Opening
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
